name: Helix Archive Terrace
source: Owner design selections questions 1-27, including delegated choices 24-27
creative_brief: Level-3 2500+ precision-engineered hybrid monumental futuristic library; tangible advanced real-world-like architecture, not decorative concept art

coordinates.x: parallel to library facade, positive right

balcony.floor: opaque composite floor and transparent observation sections

staircase.strand_construction: hybrid swept metallic structural ribbons plus exposed open lattice and joints
staircase.treads: individual composite/metal and glass-inset conceptual solids, final geometry pending
staircase.upper_entry: shared landing, separate A/B entries; remote B bridge requires spatial resolution
staircase.lower_entry: common courtyard arrival platform, two separate exits

upper_transfer.reason: Opposite-phase B entry is far from balcony; provisional top-level transfer route requires collision, egress and geometry design

courtyard.scope: two terminal structural landing pads only

support.concept: cantilevered balcony frame anchored to library superstructure plus paired overhead tension elements anchored to upper primary structure

agency_boundary.public_library: spiral stairs shall not be assumed to satisfy accessible route or required egress
agency_boundary.alternate_access: accessible elevator or compliant route required in broader library design
